scenes.locationDetail: Khaled and Nura’s hut, during the rest period
scenes.aiSummary: Jrain sees Kalima leave with an unknown companion while soldiers search houses; the party chooses to finish resting.

scenes.locationDetail: Khaled and Nura’s hut, after resting
scenes.aiSummary: Taquin speaks through baby Samir; Nura explains the remembered souls, and Finnan’s ring reveals facts about the realm.
The party crosses the village toward the dissidents, observing marked doors, the portal guardian, and the salmon pool.
Iskander explains failed escapes and Zahara’s group, then carries a warning while the party plans to approach Malquin.

scenes.locationDetail: Former bridge landing near the salmon pool
scenes.aiSummary: The party approaches the palace landing while Eolo considers materials for his magical quiver.

scenes.locationDetail: Metal rift and giant ice wolf
scenes.aiSummary: Eolo retrieves a dangerous metal shard for his quiver and draws the ice wolf’s attention.

scenes.locationDetail: Bridge landing near the salmon pool
scenes.aiSummary: The group regathers and Jrain calls in Sylvan for an audience about the planar rifts.

scenes.locationDetail: Narrow ice bridge and palace entrance
scenes.aiSummary: An ice bridge extends and the party cautiously crosses to Malquin’s palace.
Malquin’s shifting moods complicate a bargain to carry his necklace outside and return with proof of the world beyond.
The ice wolf permits passage; Jrain announces their return, and the party anchors a rope before crossing the portal.
Eolo moves a floating platform to rescue the others, and Finnan’s clairvoyance finds Eidrikas sustaining a damaged mechanism.
Ekko reunites with Eidrikas, who reports Pakrinek’s death and asks for a stolen stone piece to repair the mechanism.
Ekko reports back; the party learns four outside days have passed and decides to retrieve the stolen piece before nightfall.

entities.label: Nura
entities.aiSummary: Nura explains the infant’s remembered soul and her fear that Samir cannot survive, then directs the party toward dissidents and other sources of knowledge.

entities.label: Khaled
entities.aiSummary: Khaled shelters the party with Nura, takes the speaking infant aside, and supports Nura during the morning conversation.

entities.label: Samir
entities.aiSummary: The infant Samir watches the party during the night and speaks with an older soul’s voice in the morning. Nura fears that the remembered soul prevents Samir from developing independently.

entities.label: Taquin
entities.aiSummary: A soul calling itself Taquin speaks through Samir, identifies Zahara as its child, and shares a last memory of falling toward the labyrinth.

entities.label: Kalima
entities.aiSummary: Jrain sees Kalima leave secretly during the rest period; Taquin identifies her companion as Zahara, and Iskander says she is hidden in the cliffside mines.

entities.label: Zahara
entities.aiSummary: Zahara secretly takes Kalima to safety and is described as leader of the dissidents seeking escape. The party sends a warning through Iskander without visiting Zahara’s hideout.

entities.label: Iskander
entities.aiSummary: Iskander describes the realm’s failed escapes, the dissidents’ goals, and Malquin’s defenses. He carries the party’s warning to prepare for a possible opportunity to flee.

entities.label: Forquarion / Malquin
entities.aiSummary: The ruler’s manner shifts between courtesy, confusion, and threats as the party negotiates passage. He gives Finnan a necklace to expose to the outside night and return, promising aid if they prove the outside real and safe.

entities.label: Giant ice wolf guardian
entities.aiSummary: A forty-foot ice wolf blocks the apparently safe portal, turns toward Eolo at the metal rift, and later permits the party to pass under Malquin’s instructions.

entities.label: Eidrikas
entities.aiSummary: Ekko’s missing mentor is found painfully using his body to bridge a damaged planar mechanism. He reports Pakrinek’s death and asks the party to recover the stone piece taken by fleeing orcs.

entities.label: Pakrinek
entities.aiSummary: The party recalls Pakrinek’s expedition with Eidrikas, who later reports that orcs killed the kenku warrior at the mechanism.

entities.label: Sama, village elder
entities.aiSummary: Nura cites Sama as one of the elders who teach that children born with remembering souls cannot survive.

entities.label: Aram, village elder
entities.aiSummary: Nura cites Aram as one of the elders whose explanation attributes the infants’ condition to souls that still remember.

entities.label: Zeyfa
entities.aiSummary: The villagers’ belief that they inhabit Zeyfa’s realm is challenged by the party’s knowledge of the West Wind and Kestavo traditions.

entities.label: Melua
entities.aiSummary: Finnan recalls an ancient story of a waterfall where the Kestavo Melua was worshipped.

entities.label: Zahara’s dissident circle
entities.aiSummary: Iskander describes seven trusted dissidents seeking escape, with additional sympathizers, and agrees to warn them to be ready.

entities.label: Vejo Vaikai
entities.aiSummary: The party recalls that the Vejo Vaikai sent Eidrikas to investigate the chasm’s unnatural disturbances.

entities.label: Kemeko Monastery
entities.aiSummary: Pakrinek is recalled as a warrior of Kemeko who accompanied Eidrikas into the chasm.

entities.label: Finnan’s divination ring
entities.aiSummary: Finnan spends the ring’s charges to learn the realm’s temporal separation, boundaries, and Malquin’s control of the sky.

entities.label: Severed head of the labyrinth beast
entities.aiSummary: Justas carries the beast’s head and presents it to Malquin, whose reaction suggests an unexplained bond to the beast.

entities.label: Finnan’s collected Zimkovan tales and songs
entities.aiSummary: Finnan shows Iskander his collected tales to distinguish traditional Kestavo from Malquin.

entities.label: Eolo’s giant’s quiver
entities.aiSummary: Eolo places a shard from the metal rift into his magical quiver, which produces arrows related to its contents after a short rest.

entities.label: Metal shard from the rift
entities.aiSummary: Eolo injures his hand retrieving an exceptionally sharp, multicolored metal shard and puts it in his quiver.

entities.label: Malquin’s necklace
entities.aiSummary: Malquin gives Finnan an icy necklace to carry outside, expose to the night, and return as proof the outside world is real.

entities.label: Malquin’s sword of ice
entities.aiSummary: Malquin manifests, plants, and recalls a glittering ice sword while threatening the party during negotiations.

entities.label: Movable carved stone platform
entities.aiSummary: Eolo pushes a floating, geometrically carved stone to the portal so the party can step off its rope onto solid footing.

entities.label: Damaged planar mechanism
entities.aiSummary: A carved stone mechanism channels planar energy but sparks where it is damaged; Eidrikas bridges the break to prevent greater instability.

entities.label: Missing stone piece of the mechanism
entities.aiSummary: Eidrikas says fleeing orcs took the stone block needed to repair the damaged mechanism, making its recovery the party’s next objective.

interactions.aiSummary: Nura sleeps while the party keeps watch and Kalima leaves.
Nura describes the danger of remembering souls and directs the party toward Zahara, the elders, or Malquin.

interactions.aiSummary: Khaled sleeps in the hut while the party watches for trouble.

interactions.knownAs: The older soul speaking through Samir

interactions.aiSummary: Jrain sees Kalima secretly leave with a companion while soldiers search the village.
The infant identifies Zahara as Kalima’s companion, and Nura directs the party toward the dissidents.
Iskander reports that Zahara hid Kalima in the cliffside mines because sacrifices are not supposed to return.
Jrain sees an unidentified person leaving secretly with Kalima.
Taquin identifies Zahara as its child and Kalima’s escort; Nura describes the dissidents.
Iskander describes Zahara’s hiding places and leadership and agrees to carry the party’s warning.
Iskander explains the prison, escape attempts, and dissident plans, then agrees to warn Zahara’s group.

interactions.aiSummary: Nura identifies Malquin as a possible source of knowledge, and Finnan learns that the ruler controls the sky.
Iskander describes Malquin’s appearance, guards, and insistence that leaving would destroy villagers’ souls.
The party negotiates a reciprocal bargain to return Malquin’s necklace with proof of the outside and secure his aid and passage.

interactions.aiSummary: The giant ice wolf visibly guards the crack that resembles the chasm.
Iskander recounts the guardian’s arrival, and the party debates distracting or fighting it.
The wolf turns and opens its eyes as Eolo works near the metal rift.

interactions.aiSummary: The wolf remains still as Finnan approaches and Justas anchors a rope to its leg for crossing.
The party recalls Ekko’s missing mentor and his investigation of the chasm’s disturbances.
Finnan’s clairvoyance reveals Eidrikas painfully conducting energy through his body to hold a broken mechanism together.

interactions.aiSummary: Ekko reports Eidrikas’s predicament and the group plans recovery while allowing time to fulfill Malquin’s bargain.
Pakrinek is recalled as the Kemeko warrior who accompanied Eidrikas and failed to return.
Eidrikas reports that Pakrinek died fighting the orcs at the damaged mechanism.
Nura cites Sama among the elders who teach that souls which remember prevent an infant’s survival.
Nura cites Aram among the elders explaining the condition of remembering souls.
The party compares the realm’s ruler with Kestavo traditions and the stories of Zeyfa.
Finnan challenges the villagers’ belief that Malquin is Zeyfa’s lieutenant, explaining that the West Wind is warded off.
Finnan cites an old story of Melua’s waterfall worship.
Through Iskander, the party learns the dissidents’ escape aims and asks them to prepare for an opening.
The group recalls the Vejo Vaikai’s concern and Eidrikas’s expedition to investigate the chasm.
Pakrinek’s role as a Kemeko warrior accompanying the investigation is recalled.
Finnan’s ring reveals the realm’s bounds, sky control, and temporal separation; the DM finally clarifies that time runs slower here.

interactions.aiSummary: Eolo pushes a floating carved platform to the portal so the others can step onto it.
The party sees a damaged patterned platform and discovers through clairvoyance that Eidrikas is bridging its energy flow.
Ekko sees Eidrikas sustaining the damaged mechanism and learns it helps keep the chasm from collapsing into chaos.
The party considers recovering the missing piece before nightfall while delaying repair until their return to Malquin.
Eidrikas identifies the stolen stone block, and the party decides to pursue the orcs to recover it.
